validation_recovery.status: within-package V100 comparisons recovered; historical pixel reproduction remains failed

spec.name: SG11 robust consensus, SG12 reliable observations, SG-Diag
spec.track: W class word only; no learned tokens

sg12.score: mean raw-map cosine to all other observations, excluding self

diagnostic.definition: binary CA-to-REF flips with abs(normalized_REF-normalized_CA)>epsilon; all features interpolated to annotation resolution; GT for diagnostic labels only

spec.normalization: per-map minmax followed by bilinear upsampling, same as SG8
spec.selection: unchanged run_screen; independent SG11 and SG12 screens against W/REF; 5 fixed VOC folds; joint method/threshold selected on training folds only; >=4/5 vote and positive OOF guard
spec.tie_break: SG11 prefer larger rho then trim20; SG12 prefer more observations
spec.visual_sampling: first manifest image per named VOC class, chosen before new scores
spec.storage: resumable metric counts, per-class feature histograms, per-image reliability scores/selection, per-class pairwise sums; seven tiny temporary visual caches; no full attention or dataset-wide masks/images
